summary: Build is GREEN: `lake build Cslib.Computability.Languages.OmegaRegularLanguage` exits 0 with zero `error:` lines (only style/sorry warnings remain). Task 433's lemma `buchiCongr_DMA_accept_mem` is sorry-free and axiom-clean (verified via `#print axioms`: only [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], no sorryAx). The original blocker (broken `rw [ωAcceptor.mem_language]` in buchiCongr_DMA_language_forward/backward, caused by the goal going through the ωLanguage->Set `equiv` coercion instead of the SetLike membership pattern `mem_language` expects) was fixed in both lemmas by replacing the `rw` with `change`/`show` steps that unfold through the coercion via defeq. Fixing this exposed that the real root cause ran deeper than the two cited rw sites: buchiCongr_DMA's `accept` field needed the Muller-set/infOcc element to be the FIRST (prefix) slot of the buchiFamily pair, not the second (loop) slot, since the run's infOcc only ever contains the recurrent prefix class. I initially 'fixed' this by swapping the accept field's bound-variable order; a concurrent agent (apparently the actual task 433/435 agent, sharing this same working tree) independently fixed the same root inconsistency from the other end by correcting accept_mem's own theorem statement and its internal eqvCls/preimage closing step. The two fixes raced and briefly conflicted (both 'fixed' the same swap in opposite directions, producing a fresh type mismatch); I detected this via two consecutive failing builds, reverted my accept-field change back to the original `∃ a ∈ S, ∃ b, buchiFamily(a,b)` form (matching the now-corrected accept_mem and its doc comment), and re-aligned buchiCongr_DMA_language_backward's witness selection (`refine ⟨(b, a), ...⟩` instead of `(a, b)`) to match. Also fixed an unrelated explicit-argument bug in the backward lemma (`@buchiFamily_saturation Symbol _ State na` used positional args in the wrong order; replaced with the project's established `buchiFamily_saturation (na := na)` named-argument pattern used elsewhere in the file) and completed two further coercion-unfold steps that were hidden behind the first rw failure (the `xs ∈ (⡨ i, na.buchiFamily i)` cover step and the final `(language na).toSet` rewrite target). The whole episode landed in commit 54143599 ('task 433,435: prove buchiCongr_DMA_accept_mem + forward inclusion'), authored by the concurrent agent but incorporating my fixes to buchiCongr_DMA_language_backward (still containing exactly one preserved sorry, task 434's) -- buchiCongr_DMA_language_forward's sorry was filled in (exact accept_mem application) by that concurrent agent once the accept-field convention was settled, which is task 435's scope, not mine, but is now part of the same commit. I did not touch buchiCongr_DMA_accept_mem's mathematical content beyond confirming it builds and is sorry/axiom-clean; the one trivial closing step it was missing (`exact Set.mem_preimage.mpr rfl`, plus simplifying its unused-simp-arg list) was added by the concurrent agent, not by me.

artifacts.summary: buchiCongr_DMA_language_forward and buchiCongr_DMA_language_backward now elaborate past their original broken `rw [ωAcceptor.mem_language]` coercion issue; backward lemma is complete down to a single preserved `sorry` (task 434); buchiCongr_DMA_accept_mem (task 433) is sorry-free and axiom-clean; buchiCongr_DMA's accept-set field and its doc comment are mutually consistent (`∃ a ∈ S, ∃ b, buchiFamily (a, b) ⊓ language na nonempty`, a = infOcc/prefix index).
